skills.description: Triage and sterile bandaging under rough conditions. Hands that know where the bleeding is before the light finds it.
Surgical precision under bombardment or exhaustion. The tremor stops when the work starts, and returns afterward.
Fast patching and duct-tape maintenance on shelter structures. Nothing pretty; everything holding.
Builds and repairs with the tools and materials the shelter has left.
Knows how much wear a tool can take and how much abuse a scrap part will accept before it quits.
Pulls intelligible words out of ionospheric static and Morse loops. Other people hear weather; this one hears senders.
Rigorous scientific deduction untainted by panic or bias. The room calms down when this one starts counting instead of guessing.
Perimeter awareness that spots incoming hostiles before the ambush springs. Sleeps with one ear on the corridor.
Navigates shattered streets and dead landmarks by remembering what the rubble used to be.
A body that has made its peace with calorie deficits and bad bunker air. Runs on less, longer, and complains last.
Immediate jam-clearing drill under fire. Tap, rack, bang — the reflex is faster than the flinch.
First-shot accuracy from concealed cover. The first one is the only one that matters, and the only one they practice.
Pins hostiles behind cover while the squad moves. Not trying to hit; trying to make them stay down.
Lethal hand-to-hand and point-blank work in corridors, where the walls are part of the fight.
Rigs deadfalls and tripwires along shelter approaches. Knows exactly where a stranger's boot will land.
Spots the high-value cache points in collapsing structures — the places people hide things and never live to collect.
Morale holds through violent death and carnage. Not cruelty; the shock burned off somewhere else, a long time ago.
Extracts maximum nutrition from spoiled tins and root starch. Nothing gets thrown out until this one has argued with it.
Resists foodborne illness and irradiated-water nausea. Eats first, sets the example, usually survives.
Ferments mash and distills drinkable alcohol from sugar beet scrap. Fuel, medicine, and courage, in that order.
Clean field dressing of irradiated fauna; the bonus yield is knowing which parts are safe to keep.
Compounds clean medicinal compounds from chemical precursors. Measures twice because the second measure might not exist.
Identifies edible, medicinal, and bioluminescent bunker fungi. Knows which ones glow, which ones kill, and which ones do both.
Improvises replacement gears from copper pipe and solder. The machine never asks where the part came from.
Reinforces tunnel ceilings and vault bulkheads against seismic load. Reads cracks the way other people read sentences.
Balances duct pressure and cleans blower impellers. The shelter breathes evenly and nobody knows whose doing it is.
Harvests pristine copper wiring and steel rebar from ruins. Knows which walls are load-bearing and which are just tired.
Excavates bunker expansion tunnels safely. Shores as they go; the dark is a coworker, not an enemy.
Optimizes heat exchangers and steam recycling efficiency. Heat is a currency and this one runs the mint.
Treats severe puncture wounds in dark, shaking shelters. Steady because the patient can feel the difference.
Decisive emergency prioritization during hostile incursions. Chooses fast, chooses right, and carries the choosing afterward.
Precision tracking of tissue rem accumulation and chelation timing. Reads a dose ledger like a biography.
Pathological knowledge that reveals organ vulnerabilities and autopsy findings. The body keeps no secrets from this one, only paperwork.
Rapid trauma stabilization that beats exsanguination by minutes. The minutes are the whole discipline.
Optimal rucksack strapping for expedition carry capacity. The load never shifts, so the legs never fail.
Silent movement over glass, rubble, and creaking floorboards. The floorboards give no testimony.
Recognizes structural collapse patterns and shortcut alleys. The city is a map, and this one reads the tears in it.
Combat superiority in absolute darkness and ash blizzards. Others fear the dark; the dark knows this one by name.
Finds edible lichen and unpoisoned roots in dead scrubland. Green enough to eat is a color most people miss.
Diffuses shelter panic and resolves violent disputes with words. Lowers the volume of a room before lowering the stakes.
Impeccable inventory audits that prevent waste and theft. The ledger is a weapon, and this one keeps it sharp.
Drives work shifts with rigorous efficiency and stamina. Hated at six, thanked at midnight, right both times.
Life-saving surgical intervention against impossible odds. The odds are stated honestly, then ignored.
Refines chemical reagents and anti-rad chelation cocktails from raw minerals. Turns rocks into second chances.
Isolates animal-borne pathogens before cross-species outbreak. Watches the animals so the people don't have to learn from them.
Unwavering emotional stability that sets the shelter's morale baseline. The calm is not the absence of fear; it is furniture.
Complete psychological numbing to catastrophic casualty events. Still does the paperwork for every one. Especially every one.
Tactical coordination that boosts squad firepower. One voice turns five guns into a single decision.
Commands the respect that prevents mutiny and faction infighting. Walks into rooms that were about to become corridors.
Exceptional physical constitution; blunt trauma becomes an inconvenience. The doorframe disagrees with this one, and the doorframe loses.
Mastery of wilderness ambush and silent stalker tactics. The wasteland's food chain has an edit in it.
Deep self-reliance that lowers daily food and water consumption. Needs less, and needs it later.
Engineers high-pressure plumbing, valves, and desalination rigs. Water obeys, grudgingly, and on schedule.
Instinctive understanding of high-voltage conduits and substations. Knows which wires still remember being alive.
Reinforced blast construction and seismic shock isolation. Builds doors meant to outlive the argument about opening them.
Maintains expedition engines, chassis, and generators. Talks to them, and — this is the unsettling part — they answer.
Compounds polymer plastics and synthetic insulation. The new world's materials, built from the old world's mistakes.
Botanical intuition that maximizes greenhouse yield. The plants lean toward this one, and nobody can explain it.
Sprint stamina that cuts travel time across open ash plains. Distance is a suggestion; the horizon is a habit.
Complete concealment from optics, infrared, and auditory patrols. The guard report describes a draft.
Predicts ash blizzards and harrow fronts hours before they arrive. Watches the sky the way other people watch doors.
Remarkable biological resistance to chronic background gamma. The dosimeter keeps a record this one argues with.
Accelerated multi-disciplinary learning across technical fields. One question away from someone else's specialty.
Charismatic rhetoric capable of swaying hostile crowds. Believes the speech, which is why the speech works.
Mentors novices and accelerates apprentice progression. Measures success in other people's competence.
Investigates conspiracy records and uncovers buried bunker archives. Asks the second question, which is where the truth lives.
Radio resonance that calms listeners across the dial. People who have never met this one sleep better anyway.
Culinary mastery that turns wasteland rations into morale feasts. The same tin twice: once as food, once as occasion.
Endures prolonged double shifts without fatigue collapse. The bunker's clocks are wrong about this one, consistently.
Immunity to toxic particulate and chemical fume inhalation. Lungs that made terms with the smoke.
Forges reinforced ballistic plates and services military weaponry. The armor is the argument, and the argument is steel.
Modifies electronics and optical sensors for maximum output. Everything leaves better than it arrived, and slightly dangerous.
Preserves pre-war literature, logs, and cultural records. Keeps the before alive because the after will ask.
Combat bonus against fanatical cultists and violent raiders. Faith is fine; this one has studied where it stands.
Metabolic tolerance that prevents dependency on heavy combat stimulants. The body refuses to borrow strength it cannot repay.
Shields companions from direct attack during tactical withdrawals. Steps between — a trained motion and a chosen one.
Guides shelter decisions with matriarchal wisdom and authority. The room settles when she sits down, before she speaks.
Absolute resolve that upholds bunker cohesion through crisis. Carries the weight; does not discuss the weight.
Advanced cartography and threat detection across uncharted sectors. Maps the places, and the reasons to avoid them.
Born into the fallout; instinctive adaptation to surface hazards. Never saw the sky before, and reads it perfectly.
Optimizes strategic resource allocation with emotionless efficiency. The arithmetic is right, and the arithmetic is watched.
Grim surgical efficiency honed during the worst starvation crisis. Learned what a body is for when food stopped being one.
Leverages trade and diplomatic secrets to extract favorable terms. Collects truths the way others collect tins.
Safekeeps rare materials and prevents resource decay. Nothing leaves the hoard without a reason, and reasons are rationed.
Deep doctrine mastery that reduces friendly combat losses. Wins the fights that do not need fighting, first.
Precision breaching and explosive ordnance disposal. Argues with bombs politely, in their own language.
Concealed long-range sniping without revealing position. The shot arrives before the direction does.
Optimizes trade convoy routes and warehouse turnover. Sees the whole road at once: every axle, every bribe, every delay.
Unnatural vitality and swift injury recovery. The body decided the wasteland was not finished with its argument.
Psychological counseling that restores fractured minds. Listens the way a surgeon operates: patiently, and with clean hands.
Enhanced performance when operating solo on expeditions. Company is a luxury; solitude is a discipline.
Spreads pragmatic hope that shields allies from despair. Not sunshine — a handhold. Points at it without promising.
Inspires the devotion that unites disparate survivor factions. People behave better in rooms this one walks into, and afterward.
Dedication to patient care with zero ego or reluctance. Once kept score of a wing with their name on it; now keeps charts.
Total immunity to chemical cravings and withdrawal penalties. Counts the days in both directions and starts from the same one, now.
Unblinking vigilance that prevents nocturnal breaches. Knows every hour of every night personally.
Sensory acuity that detects hidden traps and micro-contaminants. Scared of exactly the right things, on schedule.
Mastery of incendiary weapons and flame traps. Watches fire the way others watch water — for what it does next.
Acoustic echolocation in dark tunnels and flooded shafts. Sees with the ears; the dark is just a medium.
Assembles complex machines from mismatched salvage. The machine does not know its parts have never met.
Bizarre biological symbiosis with low-level background radiation. Where others get sick, this one gets — better. Nobody says it out loud.
Locates intact pre-war relics in extreme hotspots. Goes where the counters scream and comes back with quiet things.
Absolute calm during traumatic surgery and high-stakes crafting. The pulse does not rise; the work does not shake.
Selective breeding of radiation-hardened crop strains. Plays the long game in seasons and wins it in grams.
Iron-fisted guard duty that prevents internal unrest. Stands where nobody wants to be tested, and nobody tests.
Renown that unlocks instant respect and trade concessions. The name arrives at settlements before the person does.
Drafts faction treaties and neutral accords. Writes in the grammar of shared interest, the only grammar everyone reads.
Interfaces neural cyber-implants and prosthetic limbs. Speaks fluent machine to the parts that used to be a person.
Uncovers propaganda and restores verified historical truth. Checks the story against the ledger; the ledger always wins.
Forensic autopsy insight identifying microscopic viral vectors. The dead testify; this one takes the statement correctly.
Controls critical commodity markets for maximum economic leverage. Does not corner the market — corners the thing the market needs.
Navigates subterranean ruins and flooded mine complexes. Down is a direction with its own weather, and this one dresses for it.
Eliminates freight waste and streamlines supply chains. Every crate has a story; this one edits out the boring parts.
Smelts Damascus alloys and precision-casts machine parts. Folds steel like a letter nobody else can open.
Decontaminates biological and chemical hotspots completely. Cleans the room, the air, and the record. In that order.
Clears radioactive timber and harvests dry lumber. Knows which trees are fuel, which are shelter, and which are warnings.
Maps epidemic transmission vectors across wasteland trade nodes. Draws the sickness's route before the sickness does.
Navigates by starlight and sextant when GPS and compasses fail. The old sky still works; it never signed anything.
Catalogs and preserves fragile parchment and magnetic tapes. Cotton gloves in a world that has forgotten what soft means.
Detects counterfeit currency and fraudulent barter ledgers. Reads a forgery the way a medic reads a cough.
Plays acoustic instruments that lift bunker spirits during blackouts. The blackout is the audience; the audience is everybody.
Smuggles critical medicine through enemy siege cordons. The cargo is light and the reason is heavy.
Ruthless close-range finishing strikes against armored foes. The armor has a gap; the patience finds it.
Blends into darkness to evade searchlights and thermal sensors. The light bends its reports around this one.
Infiltrates rival settlements using forged insignia and uniforms. Wears the enemy's paperwork better than the enemy does.
Restores ruined engine blocks in half the normal time. Listens once; the engine tells everything.
Secures non-aggression pacts with suspicious wasteland tribes. Sits down first, unarmed, and it keeps working.
Mastery of improvised melee weapons in brutal pit fights. Everything is a weapon; the trick is knowing which end.
Organizes entire hospital wards and triage protocols. Runs the clinic like a watch, because it is one.
Pilots aerial micro-drones for over-the-horizon reconnaissance. Sees the wasteland from the only angle it cannot hide from.
Radio singing that calms bunker distress panics. One voice, one frequency, and the panic sits down to listen.
Interlocking defensive maneuvers among tight-knit squads. Five people moving like one animal with five opinions.
Communal first-aid and wound dressing across shared dormitories. Everyone's hands trained; everyone's hands busy.
Decodes classified wartime telegrams and bunker transcripts. The war kept a diary; this one reads it aloud.
Thrives in untamed irradiated wilderness without manufactured tools. The wasteland stopped trying to kill this one out of respect.
Survives catastrophic lethal injury once per campaign. Died once, on schedule; the paperwork is still pending.
Immunity to psychic shock, trauma panic, and despair flags. The mind is a door that locks from the inside and stays locked.
Eavesdrops on raider radio comms and unencrypted walkie frequencies. The raiders never encrypted; they still do not know.
Drives brutal barter bargains that maximize shelter profit. Fair is a direction, not a destination.
Unmatched raw intellect mastering new disciplines at triple speed. Boredom is the only hazard this one reports.
Inspiring battle cries that boost squad accuracy and courage. The voice arrives before the order and does half its work.
Hydraulic bionic limb with crushing grip and recoil compensation. The arm keeps the receipts; the shoulder keeps the score.
Atones for past sins through self-sacrifice and labor. The debt is internal, and the payments are visible.
Pushes machinery beyond safety margins for emergency output bursts. The machine survives; the machine is also offended.
Defends defenseless refugees with relentless protective fury. Gentle at the table; weather in the doorway.
Total mastery of wasteland knowledge, maps, and survivor behavior. Knows who owes what, who lies, and where the water hides.
Advanced invasive trauma procedures and sterile resection under austerity. Sterility is a discipline, not a supply.
Operates ceramic, sand, and charcoal filter stages for maximum potable yield. Stands between the water and the mouth.
Vacuum-tube alignment, antenna tuning, and transmitter circuit patching. The voice in the dark depends on this solder.
Foundational reading and written communication enabling library study and technical transcription.
Arithmetic, measurement calculations, and basic problem solving.
Conflict resolution, empathy, and collective shelter duty adherence.
Hazard recognition, airlock decontamination drills, and water rationing habits.
Workshop tool handling, weld repair, and scrap reclamation.
Bandaging, antiseptics, trauma stabilization, and symptom identification.
Map reading, route plotting through ruins, and terrain hazard evasion.
Firearm discipline, defensive positioning, and emergency lockdown breach containment.
Generator maintenance, air filtration overhaul, and electrical bus troubleshooting.
Medication synthesis, sterile surgical procedures, and radiation sickness counter-therapy.
Squad maneuvering, risk calculation under fire, and retreat protocols.
Soil analysis, isotope decay monitoring, and water filtration formulation.
